subject: Luma Payments — MSA & Order Form kickoff: signer provisioning and template choice
messages:
From: Tim Chen <tim.chen@lumapay.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@lumapay.com>, legal@lumapay.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Luma + Redwood — kickoff and party details

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for sending over the intake form last week — excited to get the contracting started. Quick context: Luma is planning an initial production pilot with ~10k monthly active users and wants a 12‑month term with an option to renew. We have two business entities involved (Luma Payments, Inc. and Luma EU Holdings Ltd.).

As next steps we need:
- Confirmation of Redwood's preferred MSA template (your standard vs. enterprise addendum)
- A signer matrix for Redwood and Luma (who signs for billing vs. legal)
- Any SOC2 or data residency addenda we should expect in the MSA

I've attached a draft Exhibit A (product / roles) and a preliminary order form with the pricing line items we discussed. Can someone from your side own the intake tracker and confirm who will be Redwood's executing signatory?

Best,
Tim
Director, Partnerships
Luma Payments

Attachments: Luma_ExhibitA_draft.pdf, OrderForm_Luma_v1.xlsx

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: Tim Chen <tim.chen@lumapay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Luma + Redwood — kickoff and party details

Tim — thanks, and great to meet you over email.

We can take point on the intake tracker. Quick answers up front:
- Template: we'll start from our standard Redwood MSA and add an enterprise addendum for EU residency items if Luma requests that; I'll flag the specific clauses we expect to modify.
- Executing signatory (Redwood): our SVP of BizOps signs order forms for commercial pilots; legal signs MSAs for enterprise commitments. I'll confirm the name by EOD tomorrow.
- SOC2/data residency: we have SOC2 Type II evidence and a standard data residency addendum; if Luma needs a custom residency carveout for EU entity we will route to Private deployment options.

Looping in Laura (contracts) and Karthik (sales lead) to pick up the party sheet and redline timeline.

Kimberly Park
Head of Contracting Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Kim — I'll own the party sheet and initial redline.

Action items I'm taking:
1) Populate party-sheet (legal entity, address, tax id) for both Luma entities and Redwood counterparty mapping.
2) Flag clauses likely to change: data residency, export controls, indemnity caps (we may need to propose a mutual cap), and warranty language around model output.

Kimberly / Laura — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming Sam (cc'd) will be the billing signer and Marco is procurement contact. For signatory authority: Sam signs for billing up to $250k; legal will sign the MSA.
